title: Business Development Executive
company: St. Michael's Hospice (North Hampshire) - Agency - Permanent
description:
What are we looking for?

Are you a confident relationship-builder who can spot potential in a conversation and inspire businesses to support a local cause? We are looking for a creative and results-focused Business Development Executive who understands what motivates businesses and can build mutually beneficial partnerships. You will develop new business, build relationships with prospective partners and create tailored opportunities that generate income and wider support for St. Michael's Hospice, while helping existing corporate supporters deepen their involvement.

Key Responsibilities:
- Be an active and visible presence within the local business community, building new relationships through purposeful networking, meetings and consistent follow-up.
- Research and approach prospective corporate partners, identify shared opportunities and develop a strong pipeline of new business.
- Secure new income and support by presenting compelling ideas, making confident asks, negotiating effectively and following opportunities through to agreement.
- Develop fresh and creative partnership opportunities that go beyond traditional fundraising and offer genuine value to both the business and the Hospice.
- Grow existing corporate relationships by understanding each business's priorities and identifying opportunities to increase or broaden its support.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the Hospice to shape and deliver successful corporate partnerships.

What We're Looking For:
- Experience in business development, sales, recruitment, account management, corporate partnerships or fundraising. Charity-sector experience is welcome but not essential.
- A proactive and self-motivated approach, with the confidence to take ownership, initiate conversations and actively seek out new opportunities.
- A track record of building strong relationships and securing new business, partnerships or other tangible results.
- Confidence in networking, presenting, negotiating and making a clear ask, combined with the determination to follow opportunities through.
- A creative thinker who can spot potential, generate new ideas, make a persuasive case for them and take responsibility for turning them into action.
- Highly organised, with a consistent approach to follow-up and the ability to manage multiple relationships at different stages.
- A collaborative approach, a full driving licence, access to a car and flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends.

Why work with us?

You will join a supportive and ambitious fundraising team with an established network of corporate relationships and a clear corporate strategy to build upon. This is an outward-facing role with genuine scope to take ownership, introduce new ideas, test different approaches and influence the next stage of our corporate development.

We offer office or hybrid working with an expectation to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week and a location close to the hospice for ease of access. Plus, you'll love working in an environment where every day brings new challenges and rewards.

St. Michael's Hospice is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of vulnerable adults, children and young people. All staff are expected to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be required to undergo relevant background checks, including a DBS check and provide satisfactory reference before starting the role.

About St. Michael's Hospice

St. Michael's Hospice (North Hampshire) is a registered charity and provides support to people diagnosed with a life-limiting illness. It is a Hospice for adults providing invaluable palliative and end-of-life care services in North Hampshire, offering comfort, support, and dignity to those facing life's most challenging moments.

As a charity, we depend on the kindness and support of our local community to continue offering our services free of charge. It may come as a surprise, but only 22% of our funding comes from the government. End-of-life care is an essential service, not a luxury, yet it is not funded like other care services. To keep the Hospice's services running, we need raise an additional £15,000 every day.

Our benefits

We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits, including, free parking, life assurance, 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, and an extensive health and wellbeing plan and company pension.

Interested?
For more information or an informal chat about the role, please contact the fundraising team.

How to Apply:
To be considered for this role, please submit the following:
- Cover letter explaining why you're an ideal candidate for this position. Please note that applications without this will not be considered.
- CV outlining your relevant experience and skills.

Closing date: Friday 25 September at 12 noon

Interview Date: Wednesday 30th September in person at Millennium House, Priestley Road, RG24 9 GZ

title: Sales Executive
description:
As a Sales Executive, you'll play a key role in identifying and securing new business opportunities while maintaining strong relationships with existing clients. Your efforts will directly contribute to driving the success of the sales department and achieving company targets.

Client Details

Our client is based in Southampton, and due to a busy period and various ongoing projects, the accountancy team is looking for additional support.

Description
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the property market.
- Build and maintain relationships with existing clients to ensure repeat business.
- Prepare and deliver professional presentations to prospective clients.
- Negotiate contracts and close deals to meet sales targets.
- Analyse market trends to identify growth opportunities.
- Collaborate with the sales team to develop and implement effective strategies.
- Provide regular sales reports and updates to the management team.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the property industry and competitors.

Profile

A successful Sales Executive should have:
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with clients.
- A target-driven mindset with a focus on achieving results.
- Familiarity with the property market and industry trends.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.

Job Offer
- Base salary up to £30,000 depending on experience, plus commission.
- Permanent position.
- Opportunities to contribute to the growth of the sales department.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.
